verdict.rationale: Kong ships official CLIs (decK for declarative config/APIOps, Inso CLI for Insomnia automation) with documented commands and hands-on probe confirming decK installs and runs; docs also show CI usage patterns (lint spec, run test, export spec) suitable for AI-native/agentic workflows. missing for 10: no evidence of AI-specific CLI features (e.g., natural-language CLI commands or agent-orchestration CLI verbs) and no independent/community corroboration of CLI usability beyond vendor docs.
